title: Vehicle Scrappage Policy in India 2024: Everything You Need to Know
excerpt: A complete breakdown of the government's vehicle scrappage policy, eligibility criteria, and the benefits of scrapping through an authorized facility.
content:
India's Vehicle Scrappage Policy was introduced to phase out old, polluting, and unfit vehicles in a structured, environmentally responsible way. Under the policy, vehicles that fail fitness tests or cross defined age thresholds are directed toward Registered Vehicle Scrapping Facilities (RVSFs).

## Who Needs to Scrap Their Vehicle?

The policy sets clear thresholds for when a vehicle must be assessed for scrapping.

- Commercial vehicles older than 15 years
- Personal vehicles older than 20 years
- Any vehicle that fails its mandatory fitness test, regardless of age

## The Certificate of Vehicle Scrapping (CVS)

Owners who scrap their old vehicle through an authorized RVSF receive a Certificate of Vehicle Scrapping (CVS), which can be used to claim road tax rebates and discounts on the purchase of a new vehicle. This creates a financial incentive layered on top of the environmental one.

:::tip Road Tax Rebate
Owners who scrap through an authorized RVSF can use their CVS to claim road tax rebates and discounts on their next vehicle purchase in several states.
:::

## From Unregulated Yards to a Transparent Process

The policy also formalizes an industry that was previously dominated by unregulated scrap yards, ensuring materials are recovered safely and emissions from dismantling are controlled.

## What the Process Looks Like

1. Vehicle inspection at an authorized facility
2. Documented valuation based on weight and material recovery
3. Full RC cancellation with the RTO
4. Issuance of your Certificate of Vehicle Scrapping

For vehicle owners, every step is trackable and transparent - a marked shift from the informal scrapping practices of the past.
author: Aditya Rao

title: How Vehicle Recycling Saves the Environment
excerpt: From reduced landfill waste to lower carbon emissions, here's how certified vehicle recycling makes a measurable environmental difference.
content:
A single end-of-life vehicle contains thousands of recoverable parts and materials that would otherwise end up in landfills or informal, unregulated dismantling yards. Certified recycling recovers up to 95% of a vehicle's material by weight.

## What Gets Recovered

- Steel and aluminium body panels
- Glass and rubber components
- Plastics and interior materials
- Engine oil, coolant, and brake fluid, safely drained

## Lower Emissions Through Recycled Steel

Recycled steel requires significantly less energy to reprocess than virgin steel production, directly reducing associated CO₂ emissions. Multiply that across thousands of vehicles annually, and the cumulative environmental savings become substantial.

:::info Why This Matters
Recycled steel requires significantly less energy to reprocess than virgin steel production - and multiplied across thousands of vehicles a year, those savings add up fast.
:::

## Keeping Hazardous Fluids Out of the Ground

Beyond materials, proper dismantling also ensures hazardous fluids - engine oil, coolant, brake fluid - are safely drained and disposed of rather than leaching into soil and groundwater, which is a common risk in unregulated scrapping.

> Every vehicle recycled through a certified facility is one less source of soil and groundwater contamination.
author: Meera Iyer

title: Top 5 Benefits of Scrapping Your Old Vehicle
excerpt: Beyond the cash payout, scrapping an old vehicle unlocks tax rebates, legal protection, and peace of mind. Here are the top five reasons to do it right.
content:
Holding onto a non-running vehicle costs more than most owners realize. Here's what you gain by scrapping it through a certified facility.

## The Top 5 Benefits

1. Instant Cash Value - Even a non-running vehicle has recoverable material value, converted to immediate payment.
2. Road Tax Rebates - A Certificate of Vehicle Scrapping can unlock rebates on road tax when purchasing your next vehicle in several states.
3. Legal Protection - Cancelling your RC removes you from liability for challans, accidents, or misuse tied to a vehicle you no longer control.
4. Free Up Space - Old vehicles sitting idle occupy valuable garage or parking space that could otherwise be put to use.
5. Environmental Contribution - Choosing certified recycling over informal scrapping ensures materials are recovered responsibly rather than dumped.

:::warning Don't Wait Too Long
The longer a vehicle sits idle, the more its recoverable material value can degrade due to rust and part cannibalization. Getting a quote early locks in a fair price.
:::

## Is It Right for You?

If your vehicle has failed its fitness test, or simply costs more to maintain than it's worth, scrapping through an authorized facility is usually the simplest and most valuable option.
author: Kavya Menon

title: Documents Required to Scrap Your Vehicle: A Complete Checklist
excerpt: Avoid delays at pickup - here's the full list of documents you need ready before your vehicle is collected for scrapping.
content:
Before your scheduled pickup, make sure your paperwork is in order. Missing documents are the single biggest cause of delayed pickups.

## Checklist for Pickup Day

- Original Registration Certificate (RC)
- A government-issued photo ID matching the RC owner's name
- Latest Pollution Under Control (PUC) certificate, if available

## If the Vehicle Is Company-Registered

If the vehicle is registered under a company name, additional authorization letters and company registration documents will be required before pickup can proceed.

## If You Inherited the Vehicle

In the case of inherited vehicles, succession or NOC documents from co-owners may also be necessary to complete the transfer and cancellation.

:::info We'll Guide You
Our documentation team reviews your specific case during the quote process and provides a tailored checklist so there are no surprises on pickup day.
:::
author: Aditya Rao

title: Electric Vehicle Battery Recycling, Explained
excerpt: EV batteries need specialized handling. Here's how certified facilities safely discharge, dismantle, and recover materials from EV battery packs.
content:
Electric vehicle battery packs contain high-voltage cells that require certified discharge protocols before any physical dismantling can begin - this is a critical safety step that differentiates EV recycling from conventional vehicle scrapping.

:::warning High-Voltage Safety
EV battery packs must go through certified discharge protocols before any physical dismantling begins. Never attempt to handle a damaged EV battery pack outside a certified facility.
:::

## Materials Recovered From Battery Packs

Once safely discharged, battery packs are disassembled to recover valuable materials, which can be reintroduced into new battery production or other industrial applications.

- Lithium
- Cobalt
- Nickel
- Copper

## Building a Sustainable EV Lifecycle

As EV adoption grows in India, having certified facilities capable of this specialized processing will become increasingly important for a sustainable EV lifecycle.
author: Meera Iyer

title: Corporate Fleet Disposal: Best Practices for Businesses
excerpt: Managing the disposal of a multi-vehicle fleet involves more than a single transaction. Here's how businesses can approach it strategically.
content:
Corporate fleet disposal at scale introduces logistical complexity that individual vehicle scrapping doesn't - multiple locations, varied vehicle conditions, and consolidated compliance requirements for finance and legal teams.

## Work With a Single Scrapping Partner

Businesses benefit from working with a single scrapping partner capable of coordinating pickups across sites, batching documentation, and issuing a unified compliance report suitable for audit purposes.

:::tip Consolidated Compliance
A single partner can batch documentation across sites and issue one unified compliance report - saving your finance and legal teams significant back-and-forth.
:::

## Plan Disposal in Phases

Planning disposal in phases, rather than all at once, also helps businesses manage operational continuity while decommissioning aging fleet vehicles.

## What to Ask a Prospective Partner

- Can pickups be coordinated across multiple locations?
- Is documentation batched into a single audit-ready report?
- What is the typical turnaround time per vehicle?
author: Rajesh Khanna

title: How Is Your Vehicle's Scrap Value Actually Calculated?
excerpt: Ever wondered why two dealers quote different prices for the same vehicle? Here's what actually drives scrap valuation.
content:
Scrap valuation primarily hinges on a vehicle's total weight and the composition of recoverable materials - steel, aluminium, and other metals make up the bulk of value, with variations based on manufacturer and model.

## What Determines Scrap Value

- Total vehicle weight
- Proportion of steel, aluminium, and other recoverable metals
- Manufacturer and model-specific material composition
- Current condition of the vehicle

## Market Prices Move Valuations

Current commodity market prices for scrap steel and aluminium also influence quotes, meaning valuations can shift week to week based on broader market conditions.

:::info Spot the Signs of a Legitimate Scrapper
A transparent scrapper will break down the calculation for you rather than offering a flat number - this is the clearest sign you're dealing with a legitimate, authorized facility.
:::

## Get a Transparent Quote

Ask any scrapper to walk you through their number before you agree to a price. If they can't, it's worth getting a second quote.
author: Kavya Menon
